results.title: Manipur: Women's group holds torch rally in Imphal, demand NRC implementation before conducting Census
results.description: Women in Imphal held a torch rally demanding NRC implementation before the Census. Protests intensified across Manipur for NRC update ahead of the Census exercise. Demonstrations urged the government to defer the Census until the NRC is updated. Protesters also called for the resettlement of internally displaced persons. The group seeks government protection for life and property.
